<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">Divide state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[9:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="sr" width_description="[9:0]">Shift register for storing the dividend during division.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">The result of subtracting the divisor from the current shift register value.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out">The carry-out bit from the subtraction operation.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]">The output of the multiplexer selecting between the original shift register value and the subtraction result.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt">Counter for tracking the number of iterations performed during division.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt">Start counter flag.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_dividend" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_divisor" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="result_temp" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary result containing the remainder and quotient.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or the active-low reset signal
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and flags to their initial values
                abs_dividend <= 8'd0;
                abs_divisor <= 8'd0;
                sr <= 10'd0;
                neg_divisor <= 10'd0;
                cnt <= 1'd0;
                start_cnt <= 1'd0;
                res_valid <= 1'd0;
                result_temp <= 16'd0;
            end else begin
                // Check if there is a valid operation request and the result is not yet valid
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                    // Save the input operands
                    abs_dividend <= dividend[7] ? (~dividend + 1) : dividend;
                    abs_divisor <= divisor[7] ? (~divisor + 1) : divisor;
                    
                    // Initialize the shift register with the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit
                    sr <= {abs_dividend, 1'b0};
                    
                    // Calculate the negative value of the divisor
                    neg_divisor <= ~(abs_divisor) + 1;
                    
                    // Set the counter to 1 and enable the start counter flag
                    cnt <= 1'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'd1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Decrement the counter after each iteration
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                    
                    // Perform subtraction operation
                    sub_result = sr + neg_divisor;
                    carry_out = ~sub_result[9];
                    mux_out = carry_out ? sub_result : sr;
                    
                    // Update the shift register with the selected value
                    sr <= {mux_out[8:0], carry_out};
                    
                    // Check if the counter has reached its maximum value
                    if (&cnt) begin
                        // Clear the start counter flag and update the result
                        start_cnt <= 1'd0;
                        result_temp <= {dividend[7] ^ divisor[7], sr[8:0]};
                        
                        // Set the result valid flag
                        res_valid <= 1'd1;
                    end
                end
                
                // Manage the result valid flag based on the reset signal and the counter
                if (!rst) begin
                    res_valid <= 1'd0;
                end else if (|cnt || start_cnt) begin
                    res_valid <= 1'd1;
                end else begin
                    res_valid <= 1'd0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the result output to the temporary result
        assign result = result_temp;
        
        // Assign the absolute value of the dividend to the abs_dividend output
        assign abs_dividend = dividend[7] ? (~dividend + 1) : dividend;
        
        // Assign the absolute value of the divisor to the abs_divisor output
        assign abs_divisor = divisor[7] ? (~divisor + 1) : divisor;
    </implementation>
    
</module>
